messages:
rachel: Heads up — found a reproducible DX footgun: Vite + rollup-plugin-d-ts + @rollup/plugin-commonjs order causes default import to become undefined and TypeScript types to be stripped for our SDK when targeting edge runtimes.

omar: Ugh, short repro?

rachel: Monorepo: packages/sdk -> emits dist/index.cjs.js and dist/index.esm.js. apps/edge uses Vite -> build.ssr true, plugins: [dts(), commonjs(), react()]. When built, runtime sees `import sdk from '@redwood/sdk'` as undefined; types in consumers also disappear (no *.d.ts in bundle).

jin: Looks like dts() runs after rollup commonjs transform so the type bundle points at CJS entry. Also plugin-commonjs wraps ESM into require wrapper which removes __esModule flag.

omar: Try reordering plugins so dts runs first and force preserveNamedExports or set package.json exports with explicit import/require.

rachel: Workarounds that worked locally: (1) add "exports": {"import":"dist/index.esm.js","require":"dist/index.cjs.js"} to sdk package.json, (2) change Vite plugins order: commonjs() later, or set build.rollupOptions.input alias to the ESM file. Both restore default import and types.

jin: For DX we should: update sampleapp templates to prefer exports field, add a short note in the SDK publishing checklist about plugin order, and add a CI job that runs sampleapp build with Vite+commonjs+dts to catch regressions.

devex-bot: Issue created #2237: "vite plugin order causes ESM/CJS default import + d.ts loss".

rachel: I'll open a tiny PR to sampleapp to demonstrate minimal fix and a README blurb explaining the plugin-order trap and the recommended package.json `exports` snippet.

omar: Thanks — adding to onboarding checklist too.
